description: Flat per-record metadata schema for electrophysiological recordings in rodent brain slices with pharmacological modulation of neurotransmitter systems and synaptic plasticity outcomes.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the dataset record or experimental observation.

study_id.descr: Identifier linking the record to a parent study or experiment series.

publication_title.descr: Title of the published study or preprint supporting the finding, if applicable.

publication_doi.descr: Digital Object Identifier (DOI) for the supporting publication, if available.

publication_pmid.descr: PubMed ID for the supporting publication, if available.

publication_year.descr: Year the supporting study was published.

species.descr: Rodent species used, e.g., Rattus norvegicus or Mus musculus.

strain.descr: Animal strain or line, e.g., C57BL/6J, Sprague-Dawley.

sex.descr: Sex of the animal used, e.g., male, female, mixed, unknown.

age_days.descr: Age of the animal at tissue collection, in days postnatal or age in days.

age_description.descr: Additional age descriptor when exact age_days is not sufficient, e.g., adult, juvenile, P21-P28.

brain_region.descr: Brain region from which the slice was prepared, e.g., hippocampus, cortex, striatum.

subregion.descr: More specific anatomical subregion, layer, or nucleus, if applicable.

slice_plane.descr: Slice orientation, e.g., coronal, sagittal, horizontal.

slice_thickness_um.descr: Thickness of the brain slice in micrometers (µm).

recording_temperature_c.descr: Temperature during recording in degrees Celsius (°C).

preparation_temperature_c.descr: Temperature used during slice preparation, in degrees Celsius (°C), if reported.

recording_mode.descr: Patch-clamp recording mode, e.g., whole-cell voltage clamp, current clamp, cell-attached.

patch_clamp_configuration.descr: Detailed patch configuration, e.g., whole-cell, perforated patch, loose patch.

cell_type.descr: Recorded cell class or identity, e.g., pyramidal neuron, interneuron, granule cell.

cell_marker.descr: Molecular or electrophysiological marker used to identify the cell type, if any.

holding_potential_mv.descr: Membrane holding potential during recordings, in millivolts (mV).

stimulation_type.descr: Type of synaptic stimulation used, e.g., electrical stimulation, optogenetic stimulation, spontaneous events.

stimulation_site.descr: Location of stimulation electrode or input pathway.

neurotransmitter_system.descr: Primary neurotransmitter system investigated, e.g., glutamatergic, GABAergic, cholinergic, dopaminergic.

receptor_target.descr: Specific receptor or receptor family investigated for causal impact, e.g., AMPA, NMDA, GABA_A, mGluR5, D1.

ligand_or_drug_name.descr: Name of the applied pharmacological agent or endogenous ligand used to modulate the receptor/system.

ligand_or_drug_class.descr: Pharmacological class, e.g., agonist, antagonist, inverse agonist, modulator, uptake inhibitor.

ligand_concentration_uM.descr: Concentration of the pharmacological agent in micromolar (µM), if applicable.

ligand_application_route.descr: How the agent was applied, e.g., bath, puff, intracellular, local perfusion.

ligand_application_duration_min.descr: Duration of drug exposure in minutes, if reported.

washout_observed.descr: Whether washout/reversibility was tested or observed.

coadministered_agents.descr: Other pharmacological agents present in the same experiment, if any.

control_condition_description.descr: Description of the control condition used for comparison.

synaptic_response_type.descr: Measured synaptic response, e.g., EPSC, IPSC, EPSP, mEPSC, paired-pulse ratio.

plasticity_paradigm.descr: Plasticity protocol or paradigm, e.g., LTP, LTD, paired-pulse facilitation, STDP.

response_amplitude_mean.descr: Mean synaptic response amplitude, in pA or mV as appropriate.

response_amplitude_sd.descr: Standard deviation of response amplitude, in pA or mV.

response_frequency_hz.descr: Event frequency, in Hz, for spontaneous or miniature events.

response_latency_ms.descr: Response latency after stimulus, in milliseconds (ms).

plasticity_change_percent.descr: Percent change in synaptic response or plasticity metric relative to baseline or control.

effect_direction.descr: Direction of the observed effect on synaptic transmission or plasticity, e.g., increase, decrease, no_change.

causal_interaction_description.descr: Plain-language description of the causal interaction identified between receptor/system manipulation and synaptic plasticity outcome.

causal_support_level.descr: Strength of causal evidence, e.g., correlational, pharmacological blockade, rescue, knockdown, knockout, direct manipulation.

statistical_test.descr: Statistical test used to evaluate the result, if reported.

p_value.descr: Reported p-value for the main causal or synaptic effect, if available.

effect_size.descr: Effect size for the main comparison, if reported.

effect_size_type.descr: Type of effect size, e.g., Cohen's d, partial eta squared, fold change.

n_animals.descr: Number of animals contributing to the record.

n_cells.descr: Number of recorded cells or patches analyzed.

replicate_type.descr: Whether the record represents technical replicate, biological replicate, or independent experiment.

notes.descr: Free-text notes relevant to interpretation, caveats, or deviations from standard protocol.
